title: SecOps-NG Supply-Chain Dependency Kind
description: Closed alphabet for the kind of external dependency a supply-chain evidence snapshot enumerates. Promoted out of the F-CP-03 supply-chain evidence stream so the per-record `dependencies[].kind` field, downstream KPI / KRI catalog entries (`kpi.sovereign_provider_share@v1`, `kri.non_sovereign_call_surge@v1` — land in the EXTEND-metrics sibling), and any future per-kind rollup share one vocabulary without re-declaring it. Extending the alphabet is a discussion, not a drive-by change.

x_kind_definitions.software_dependency: Pinned library, package, or SBOM line the workflow links against at build or load time (PyPI / npm / crates.io / OS-package / container-image layer).
x_kind_definitions.hosted_api: External HTTP API the workflow calls at execution time (REST, GraphQL, gRPC). Includes both first-party and third-party endpoints outside the operator's sovereign boundary.
x_kind_definitions.data_feed: External subscription, threat-intel feed, indicator stream, or reference dataset the workflow ingests on cadence.
x_kind_definitions.ai_provider: LLM, embedding, classifier, or other inference endpoint the workflow calls. Carved out from `hosted_api` because the sovereignty test against AI providers is the lever the EU AI Act and NIS2 supply-chain overlays read.
x_kind_definitions.managed_runtime: PaaS, FaaS, or other managed host the workflow itself executes inside (Temporal Cloud, Modal, Lambda, Cloud Run). The runtime is itself a supply-chain dependency for the workflow it carries.
